This reduces the number of memory transactions and allows the hardware to better coalesce accesses, reducing L2 pressure and L1TEX stall cycles. Additionally, adding @triton.autotune allows exploration of XBLOCK/YBLOCK tile shapes that improve spatial locality for both the strided load and the contiguous store.
